# Graveyard Keeper 2 Wiki

> An unofficial player-made wiki for Graveyard Keeper 2: the console-commands and cheats truth, beginner guides, and troubleshooting for every progression blocker. Verified and dated after every game update.

Wiki for Graveyard Keeper 2 (PC (Steam), by Lazy Bear Games). Articles cover boss guides, tier lists, codes, items, and beginner tips.

## Articles

- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Achievements — All 38, With Conditions](https://wenta0v0-dot.github.io/graveyardkeeper2-guide/achievements/all-achievements/): Graveyard Keeper 2 has 38 achievements worth 1,000 Gamerscore. Thirty-three have public unlock conditions, quoted here in full; five are hidden, and where community databases report their triggers we say so and label the source instead of dressing a guess up as a fact. The grind-heavy counters are listed separately.
- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Cheats & Console Commands (October 2026) — The Truth](https://wenta0v0-dot.github.io/graveyardkeeper2-guide/codes/all-codes/): No working text codes or built-in console commands have been documented for Graveyard Keeper 2 as of version 1.008 (October 2026). The real speed-ups are the automation economy: zombie workers, factory lines, and church income. This page proves the claim, explains what to do instead, and is re-checked after every game update.
- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Factory Automation Guide — Conveyors and Iron](https://wenta0v0-dot.github.io/graveyardkeeper2-guide/guides/factory-automation-guide/): The underground factory turns the manual grind into a conveyor-fed supply chain. This guide walks the full unlock path, your first Zombie Carousel, the iron run to the town warehouse, and a checklist for the moment the line stops — because at some point, it will stop.
- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Faith Guide — Earning It and Spending It](https://wenta0v0-dot.github.io/graveyardkeeper2-guide/guides/faith-guide/): Faith in Graveyard Keeper 2 funds Inspiration, zombie creation and some fast travel — and it is the resource players run out of first. This guide explains how sermons and prayers generate it, why early faith feels slow, and which spending is worth the wait.
- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Money Guide — What Actually Earns Coin](https://wenta0v0-dot.github.io/graveyardkeeper2-guide/guides/money-guide/): Coin in Graveyard Keeper 2 comes from four streams that scale: village crops, the paint production chain, town merchant orders, and church income. This guide explains how each one unlocks, which to build first, and the busywork that only looks like profit once energy is your scarce resource.
- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Zombie Workers Guide — Tasks, Setups and Fixes](https://wenta0v0-dot.github.io/graveyardkeeper2-guide/guides/zombie-workers-guide/): Zombie workers are the real speed-up: unlock them via the Plague Doctor's Sweet Dreams quest, prepare a corpse with five red skulls, then staff lumber, quarry and farm stations so the dead do the work your energy used to. This guide covers every setup, the tool requirements, and the fixes for idle zombies.
- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Beginner Guide — Your First Days in the Yard](https://wenta0v0-dot.github.io/graveyardkeeper2-guide/guides/beginner-guide/): Graveyard Keeper 2 runs on three engines: the graveyard-and-church pair that converts corpses into faith and money, the tech tree that unlocks the town and the Royal Foundry, and the automation economy of zombie workers and factory lines. This guide explains each engine, the order to build them in, and the mistakes that stall new keepers.
- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Troubleshooting — Steel, the Foundry & Blockers](https://wenta0v0-dot.github.io/graveyardkeeper2-guide/guides/troubleshooting/): The Graveyard Keeper 2 progression blockers players hit most: steel and the Royal Foundry tech line, Polished Bronze and Bronze Detail, orders with Jack and the warehouse, faith income, and zombie mining. Each blocker below explains where the answer lives in-game and what typically unsticks it — checked against version 1.008.
- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Alchemy Cheat Sheet — Runes, Formulas, Ingredients](https://wenta0v0-dot.github.io/graveyardkeeper2-guide/items/alchemy-runes-cheat-sheet/): Alchemy in Graveyard Keeper 2 is arithmetic, not recipes: every ingredient carries red, green and blue rune values, and a brew works only when the totals match a formula exactly. This cheat sheet lists all 29 formulas with their rune totals, the ingredient values verified so far, and the lab rules the game never explains.
- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Main Quest Walkthrough — All 7 Acts in Order](https://wenta0v0-dot.github.io/graveyardkeeper2-guide/quests/main-quest-walkthrough/): Graveyard Keeper 2 runs 41 journal quests across seven acts, book-ended by an unjournaled prologue: the prison escape, Larry, the sewers and your first burial. This walkthrough lists every act in order with its quest names, the reputation and quality gates that stall progress, and the weekday locks the game explains nowhere.
- [Graveyard Keeper 2 Patch Notes — Every Update, Dated](https://wenta0v0-dot.github.io/graveyardkeeper2-guide/updates/patch-notes/): This page tracks every Graveyard Keeper 2 update since the September 22 launch, in one dated log: what each version fixed, what it rebalanced, which progression bugs died, and what the developers have publicly planned next. Re-checked after every patch — the same promise as our codes page.
